title: Cannot access website from Russia. Russia is blacklisted.
body:
## details
OS: windows
Browser: chrome/firefox
country: Russia
Method: opening website

## problem

![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/ab7cc451-845b-4ad1-8609-b8e4f6111339)

## How can we help?

Remove Russia from blacklist
